title: Lackfelt releases a soulful track for the hesitant with “On The Fence”
htmlContent: Lackfelt makes a strong impression with his newest song, “On The Fence.” This heartfelt track dives into the confusing feelings that come with love and indecision. Already gaining popularity with over 600,000 views and 100,000 likes on TikTok, Lackfelt is an artist to watch. “On The Fence” draws you in with its emotional blend of sadness and hope. There’s a genuine feeling in the way he sings, both open and powerful, which makes it easy to relate to the struggles he describes. The song tells a story that many can relate to, especially those who have felt torn between staying in a relationship or stepping away. The chorus is wrapped in beautiful music that builds enough to create emotional tension without overwhelming the listener. https://open.spotify.com/track/3y8b4LW9UHedp2cDGx7656?si=BYBDrWHNQh6AhU0WJQkhnw Supported by the artist development company 10XADA, Lackfelt is emerging with a sound that mixes the authenticity of indie music with a broader appeal. “On The Fence” is a chance to reflect, serving as the perfect backdrop for feelings we often keep to ourselves. Follow on: TikTok/Instagram
